_about: The numbers the viewer still COMPUTES instead of reading verbatim from the event log or the content sheet. Each is a debt the engine owes as an event or a sheet field (THREE-PACKAGES-PLAN.md §8.3). This list may only SHRINK: verify.mjs fails if the source carries an 'EXEMPTION <name>' marker not listed here, an entry here with no marker left in the source, or more entries than the committed file had (ALLOW_EXEMPTION_GROWTH=1 overrides once, for a review that FINDS an unmarked computation — that is discovery, not growth). Delete the entry the day the engine emits the number.

tick-projection.becomes: an engine event (tick.forecast, name provisional) emitted when a unit's statuses or protection change

dmg-fallback.computes: stat + bonus for a resting attack row before its damageOnHit has been seen
dmg-fallback.becomes: the sheet states the fields separately, or the engine emits the live figure

danger.computes: stat + bonus of the first attack for the danger marker, AND the DANGER_AUTHORED table of four typeIds (zombies at 3 melee, ruled 2026-09-01) that content has no field for yet
danger.becomes: an authored bestiary field, or the same live figure

move-range.computes: movement + budgetMod for a path/flight move's range
move-range.becomes: the sheet states the move's range; move.begin already carries the real budget

base-accuracy.computes: prints the sheet's BASE accuracy as the resting row's ACC
base-accuracy.becomes: the engine emits the live accuracy, or the row is labelled base

sheet.computes: resolves a unit's attack/ability/move ids to definitions
sheet.becomes: engine/src/content sheetOf(typeId), exported through both doors (plan §8.3 correction 1)

aim-mitigation.computes: the target's BASE armor/resist off the sheet, printed as −N ARMOR on the forecast
aim-mitigation.becomes: attack.declared carries the live mitigation figure

stat-delta.where: src/actions.js modOf / mvOf (was src/panel.js modOf; moved 2026-09-03 so the movement numeral and the panel share the one sum)
stat-delta.computes: the per-stat sum of statmod.added values AND the kit's unit.equipped stat deltas, printed as the stat's delta and added to the resting movement numeral
stat-delta.becomes: statmod.added carries the running total per stat; unit.enter carries the fielded stat block (viewer/ENGINE-FINDINGS-2026-09-03.md #3)

cooldown-left.computes: readyOnTurn − the folded turn, printed as turns until usable
cooldown-left.becomes: cooldown.set carries turnsLeft, or the bar prints the ready turn
